jobs.title: Pricing Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
The Pricing Strategy Manager will serve as a strategic pricing partner to Product Managers across the company’s AI and Contact Center software portfolio. Reporting to the Pricing Director, this role brings deep pricing and monetization expertise to PM-led pricing and packaging proposals by helping strengthen commercial rigor.

This role acts as a dedicated thought partner responsible for pressure-testing assumptions, filling analytical gaps, and ensuring proposals are financially sound, operationally feasible, and aligned with pricing best practices.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter who can independently manage a complex workload of pricing proposals and flex between pricing strategy support, analytical modeling, governance coordination, implementation feasibility discussions and strategic pricing project initiatives depending on business needs. Product Managers retain ownership of proposals and domain direction; this role strengthens and challenges the work to ensure every proposal meets a high commercial standard.

Key Responsibilities:

- PM Pricing Partnership

- Partner with Product Managers to strengthen pricing and packaging recommendations for new and existing products through pricing expertise, analytical support, and structured challenge across:

- Strategic Alignment: competitive positioning, internal product and strategy alignment, unit economics / forecasting

- Pricing Model Design: meter / unit of measure selection, packaging structure, buying rules

- Operational Feasibility: technical product and billing/CPQ feasibility

- Identify gaps, inconsistencies, or risks in pricing proposals and help refine thinking through structured feedback — operating with a high degree of autonomy and minimal oversight from the Pricing Director

- Provide targeted research and analytical support to strengthen proposal builds as needed (e.g. financial modeling, competitive benchmarking); leverage business partners where appropriate

- Support PMs in navigating cross-functional operationalization requirements for pricing changes

- Pricing Committee & Governance

- Prepare PMs to present proposals to the Pricing Committee

- Coordinate Pricing Committee activities — including scheduling, documenting decisions, and communicating approved changes across the organization

- Maintain pricing documentation as the source of truth and proactively cascade changes to impacted teams and systems (e.g., SFDC/CPQ, website, sales enablement)

- Analytics & Research

- Support development and maintenance of pricing analytics and dashboards — including discounting analysis, pricing performance monitoring, and packaging optimization — either directly or in partnership with BI resources

- Conduct ad hoc strategic pricing research and monitor market trends across the SaaS, AI, and Contact Center landscape

- Serve as a resource to Sales and Deal Desk on pricing and packaging Q&A

Requirements:

- 5+ years of experience in pricing, strategy & ops, management consulting, FP&A, or related analytical roles in B2B SaaS

- Strong command of SaaS pricing best practices across model design, packaging, and monetization strategy

- Ability to build and review financial models, pressure-test assumptions and translate data into business implications

- Clear, structured communicator – able to give direct, constructive feedback to Product Managers and translate pricing concepts into actionable guidance

- Collaborative and direct: confident enough to push back on a PM's thinking constructively, trusted enough to be a genuine partner rather than a blocker

- Proven ability to work effectively with multiple teams, manage competing priorities, and drive alignment across the organization

- Highly organized self-starter; comfortable managing a high-volume workload independently, maintains documentation standards, and drives initiatives to completion without close supervision

- Familiarity with Salesforce and business intelligence platforms; CPQ experience a plus

Preferred:

- Experience in SaaS, AI, or Contact Center software strongly preferred

- Familiarity with usage-based, subscription, or outcome-based pricing models

- Knowledge of quote-to-cash processes, billing systems, and contract structures

- Exposure to competitive pricing analysis or willingness-to-pay frameworks

- Background in supporting pricing committees or governance processes

Base Salary Range :  $93,000 - $140,000

Other Types of Pay : Based on level and role the employee may be eligible for long term incentives in the form of equity and short term incentives of either bonus or commission.

Health Insurance : Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance, Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

Retirement Benefits : 401(k) plan

Paid Time Off : Talkdesk offers an uncapped paid time off program for exempt employees and an accrual-based program for non-exempt employees; both are subject to manager approval and consistent with business needs.

Paid Holidays : Talkdesk offers 14 paid holidays each year.

Paid Sick Leave : Exempt employees have uncapped paid time off and non-exempt sick leave follows accrual standards; both are subject to manager approval and consistent with business needs.

Method of Application : Apply online.

Application Window : The application window is expected to close at least 7 days from the posting date. The application was posted on 10/4/2026.

Benefits and perks listed above may vary based on the nature of your employment with Talkdesk.

All questions or concerns about this posting should be directed to the Talent team at  Talent@talkdesk.com .

jobs.title: Senior Manager, FP&A - GTM
jobs.description:
We are looking to hire a Senior Manager, FP&A to be a strategic business partner with our Sales and Marketing organization. This individual will be responsible for partnering cross-functionally with senior management to build annual budgets, manage forecasts, and provide decision support through financial analyses to ensure optimal returns on strategic investments. This is a key position providing guidance on financial and operational matters across the entire organization.

Duties and Responsibilities:

- Serve as the strategic finance partner to Sales and Marketing leadership (CRO, CMO, and their teams), influencing go-to-market strategy, investment priorities, and resource allocation

- Own the GTM portion of the annual operating plan, quarterly reforecasts, and long-range plan, including bookings, pipeline, quota capacity, headcount, and Sales & Marketing operating expenses

- Lead capacity and productivity planning with Sales Operations: rep hiring plans, ramp assumptions, quota setting, territory coverage, and attainment

- Partner with Marketing to model and optimize demand-gen spend, pipeline contribution, funnel conversion, and channel ROI

- Own reporting and analysis of key GTM and SaaS unit economics, including ARR, net new ARR, net and gross revenue retention, churn, CAC, CAC payback, LTV:CAC, and S&M efficiency (magic number)

- Lead monthly and quarterly close for S&M: budget-vs-actual and forecast-vs-actual variance analysis, holding leaders to their budgets and explaining what drove performance

- Prepare and present Sales & Marketing performance updates, business reviews, and recommendations to the executive team, and contribute GTM content to board materials

- Build business cases and scenario models for major GTM decisions, such as new segments or geographies, pricing and packaging, partner/channel programs, and large marketing investments

- Partner with Sales Ops, Accounting, and HR/Total Rewards on sales compensation plan design, cost modeling, and commission expense forecasting

- Build, lead, and develop a team of FP&A analysts, setting priorities, coaching for growth, and raising the bar for analytical quality

- Drive scalable GTM planning and reporting by improving processes, systems, and data integration across CRM (e.g., Salesforce), planning tools, and BI dashboards

Qualifications:

- 8+ years of relevant finance experience preferred; SaaS experience strongly preferred

- 3+ years of experience supporting Marketing organizations and budgets

- Experience building out models to evaluate Marketing program spend ROI and pipeline generation efficiency

- Knowledge of Sales/Marketing and applicable key metrics – ARR, MRR, pipeline, conversion/win rates, CAC, LTV

- Strong financial and operational planning skills

- Experience partnering with Senior Leadership and ability to influence at all levels of an organization

- Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) with experience developing and delivering presentations

- Expertise in building Excel-based financial models, with an emphasis on aggregating and analyzing data to provide actionable insights

- Ability to multi-task effectively, working in team environments or independently

- Experience with headcount reconciliation and month-end budget/forecast vs actuals reconciliation

- Four-year university degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or related field required

- Experience with financial systems: Adaptive, NetSuite, Zuora, Coupa, Salesforce

Pay Range (Base Pay) :   $150,000 - 200,000

Other Types of Pay : Based on level and role the employee may be eligible for long term incentives in the form of equity and short term incentives of either bonus or commission.

Health Insurance : Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance, Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

Retirement Benefits : 401(k) plan

Paid Time Off : Talkdesk offers an uncapped paid time off program for exempt employees and an accrual-based program for non-exempt employees; both are subject to manager approval and consistent with business needs.

Paid Holidays : Talkdesk offers 14 paid holidays each year.

Paid Sick Leave : Exempt employees have uncapped paid time off and non-exempt sick leave follows accrual standards; both are subject to manager approval and consistent with business needs.

Method of Application : Apply online.

Application Window : The application window is expected to close at least 5 days from the posting date. The application was posted on 10/05/2026

jobs.title: Data Governance & Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Data Governance & Compliance Manager to join our Information Security team. In this role, you will own the strategy and execution of Talkdesk's data governance program , covering data lifecycle management, retention, privacy rights management, data classification, and data protection controls. You will work closely with Legal & Privacy, Product, Engineering, Security, and business stakeholders to translate regulatory and contractual requirements into practical, scalable controls, processes, and tooling.

This is a highly cross-functional role that requires a combination of strong data governance and privacy expertise, project leadership, technical understanding, and the ability to influence stakeholders across the organization.

What You'll Own

Data Governance & Compliance Strategy

- Build and own the roadmap for Talkdesk's data governance program, from requirements and design through implementation, measurement, and continuous improvement.

- Define and maintain data governance policies, procedures, standards, and controls covering data classification, retention, privacy rights management, and data protection.

- Embed governance requirements into engineering and data processes, enabling teams to follow secure and compliant practices by default.

- Monitor regulatory developments, including GDPR, CCPA, and other global privacy regulations, and translate them into actionable governance requirements.

- Assess projects and initiatives to ensure compliance with applicable data governance, privacy, and regulatory requirements.

- Identify opportunities where strong data governance can create business value, improve customer trust, and enable responsible data use.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Execution

- Partner closely with Legal & Privacy to translate regulatory and contractual requirements into practical governance controls.

- Collaborate with Product and Engineering to embed data governance and privacy-by-design principles into products, systems, and technical architecture.

- Drive complex, multi-team initiatives across Engineering, Security, Product, Legal, and business functions.

- Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, timelines, and success criteria with senior stakeholders.

- Identify and manage dependencies, risks, critical paths, and milestones through to completion.

- Build business cases for governance initiatives and communicate their impact to senior leadership.

- Define KPIs and reporting mechanisms that demonstrate both risk reduction and business value.

- Prepare governance and compliance reports for management, auditors, and other relevant stakeholders.

- Promote a culture of responsible data use and privacy-by-design across the organization.

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in data governance, privacy, compliance, GRC, or a related field.

- Proven experience building, implementing, or scaling data governance programs.

- Strong understanding of global privacy regulations , particularly GDPR and similar frameworks.

- Ability to translate regulatory and privacy requirements into practical policies, processes, controls, and technical requirements.

- Experience working with Data Lifecycle Management, Data Classification, Consent Management, Privacy Rights Management, and Data Protection .

- Experience driving highly technical, multi-team initiatives across Engineering and other business functions.

- Strong understanding of security and compliance frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and SOC 2 is a plus.

- Experience working with tools such as Google Workspace, Confluence, and Jira .

- Experience with OneTrust, Vanta, or other GRC/data governance platforms is a plus.

- Strong track record of improving data trust, privacy posture, compliance maturity, or customer experience.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience preferred.

Who You Are

- A critical thinker who can navigate complex and ambiguous problems.

- Highly organized, with strong planning and project management skills.

- A confident decision-maker who can balance risk, compliance, and business priorities.

- An excellent communicator who can adapt messaging to technical, legal, business, and executive audiences.

- A strong influencer who can drive alignment without relying solely on formal authority.

- Collaborative and comfortable working across multiple teams and regions.

- Skilled at negotiation and conflict management.

- Adaptable, resilient, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, global environment.

- A self-starter who is willing to dive into complex or unfamiliar problems and drive them through to resolution.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means:

- Talkdesk has a clear, scalable, and measurable data governance strategy .

- Engineering and Product teams can incorporate governance and privacy requirements into their workflows without unnecessary friction.

- Data is appropriately classified, retained, protected, and managed throughout its lifecycle.

- Privacy and regulatory requirements are translated into clear and actionable technical controls.

- Governance investments demonstrate measurable improvements in risk reduction, data trust, compliance maturity, and business value .

- Talkdesk continues to strengthen a culture of responsible data use and privacy-by-design across the organization.

jobs.title: Senior People Business Partner – Go-to-Market (Sales & Marketing)
jobs.description:
🚀 About the Role

Talkdesk is seeking a highly strategic, high-autonomy Senior People Business Partner  to drive the organizational health, talent strategy, and commercial scale of our Go-to-Market (GTM) organization, focusing specifically on Sales and Marketing .

Operating within our regional PBP model, you will partner directly with VP-and-below leaders across Enterprise Sales, Inside Sales, Channel Sales, Field Marketing, Brand, and Marketing Operations. Your mission is to align people strategy with aggressive revenue and growth targets, building a high-performing, agile commercial organization. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for an experienced HR practitioner who thrives in a fast-paced, quota-driven environment and can flex seamlessly between strategic coaching and execution.

🎯 What You'll Do

As the dedicated Senior PBP for Sales & Marketing, your core responsibilities will include:

Sales & Marketing Client Partnership

- GTM Advisory: Act as the primary People Business Partner for our AMER Sales and Marketing organizations, building strong, consultative relationships with VP-level commercial leaders.

- Commercial Org Design: Provide guidance on sales and marketing organizational design, including optimizing territory coverage models, spans of control, marketing team structures, and capacity planning.

- Incentive & Compensation Strategy: Partner with Sales Operations and Total Rewards to advise on sales compensation structures, commission dynamics, merit cycles, promotions, and strategic offer construction for highly competitive GTM talent.

- Talent Pipelines: Partner with Recruiting to execute aggressive headcount planning, build robust talent pipelines, and refine role scoping to attract top-tier commercial talent.

AI-Driven Transformation & GTM Enablement

- AI Fluency in GTM: Champion Talkdesk's AI Fluency competency framework within Sales and Marketing, embedding AI expectations into core sales methodologies, marketing competencies, and calibration conversations.

- Modernizing GTM Workflows: Serve as a change agent helping Sales and Marketing teams adopt AI-first ways of working (e.g., AI-assisted lead gen, automated sales prospecting, and AI-driven content generation).

- Enablement & Coaching: Partner with sales and marketing managers to coach employees toward Practitioner, Builder, and Strategist-level AI fluency, designing targeted performance plans where necessary.

- Performance Calibration: Lead localized mid-year and annual review cycles, ensuring performance ratings, sales quotas, and AI fluency benchmarks are calibrated fairly and consistently.

Performance, Culture, & Global Alignment

- High-Performance Culture: Coach sales and marketing managers on navigating high-pressure performance dynamics, managing PIP processes, and structuring clear career progression paths.

- Engagement & Retention: Drive targeted retention and engagement strategies for high-performing, high-potential (HiPo) commercial talent, using data from engagement surveys (e.g., Peakon/Workday) to build leadership action plans.

- Global Collaboration: Collaborate with the broader regional PBP team (Americas, EMEA, APAC/Philippines) to ensure global consistency across our international commercial offices and navigate multi-jurisdictional sales employment structures.

👤 What You'll Bring

- Professional Experience: 8+ years of progressive HR/People Business Partner experience, with a strong preference for direct support of high-performing Sales, Marketing, or broader GTM functions .

- ELT-Adjacent Partnership: Demonstrated experience operating at a senior level, successfully advising VP and above stakeholders in a fast-paced, matrixed commercial setting.

- GTM HR Technical Expertise:

- Strong working knowledge of global employment laws (US required; EMEA/APAC exposure highly valued).

- Robust understanding of sales compensation, variable commission structures, and incentive design.

- Proven experience with organizational design, capacity planning, and scaling sales/marketing teams.

- Change Leadership: Experience leading large-scale cultural or technological change, with an enthusiasm for AI-driven transformation and translating AI adoption goals into GTM success.

- Industry & Tools Acumen:

- Experience working within a CCaaS, SaaS , or high-growth tech environment.

- Familiarity with modern HRIS and People tools (e.g., Workday, Greenhouse, Deel, Okta) as well as general awareness of GTM tech stacks.

- Core Competencies: Exceptional business acumen, absolute discretion, strong executive presence, and the ability to translate complex People metrics into clear business actions.

🏆 Success in This Role Looks Like

- Strategic Integration: You are established as an indispensable business advisor to our Sales & Marketing leaders, actively helping them hit commercial milestones through people programs.

- Smooth Executions: Flawless execution of performance, quota alignment, and compensation cycles with minimal friction or escalation.

- Talent Retention: High retention of top-performing sales reps, account executives, and key marketing leaders.

- AI Adoption: Measurable progress on AI fluency adoption across the GTM organization, establishing Talkdesk's sales and marketing teams as models of an AI-first culture.

Other Types of Pay : Based on level and role the employee may be eligible for long term incentives in the form of equity and short term incentives of either bonus or commission.
